div.head: I Cn 5a
div.ab: ⁊ æt þryfealdre spæce ladige he, gyf he durre, eac on þam husle mid twam his gehádan.
And æt þryfealdre sprace ladige, gif he durre, eac on þam husle mid twam his gehádan.
in triplici calumpnia: cum duobus sui ordinis.
⁊ æt þryfealdre spæce ladige he, gyf he durre, eac on þam husle mid twam his gehádan.
And æt þryfealdre spæce ladige he, gyf he durre, eac on þam husle mid twam his gehadan.
And in the case of a triple accusation he shall also clear himself, if he dares, by the Holy Communion with two supporters of the same ecclesiastical rank as himself.
And if it is a threefold accusation, he shall, if he dares, exonerate himself through the sacrament and the oaths of two clerics of his rank.
Und von dreifacher Anklage reinige er sich, wenn er es wagt, ebenfalls durch den Abendmahlsgenuss mit zweien seiner Standesgenossen.
And from a threefold accusation let him clear himself, if he dares, likewise by [taking] the sacrament, with two of his fellow-clergy.

div.note: The Instituta Cnuti add 5aa: the priest is to be held until the bishop's judgment (compare II Cn 42). Liebermann compares VIII Atr 19.1.
